verses.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.encouragement: Every verse you hide in your heart today is one you can draw on tomorrow.

verses.text: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.encouragement: His mercies are new every morning, and so is today's chance to meet Him in the Word.

verses.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verses.encouragement: Day and night starts with a few minutes today.

verses.text: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.encouragement: The Bereans searched the Scriptures daily. Join them today.

verses.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.encouragement: A lamp lights the next step. Let today's verse light yours.

verses.text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.encouragement: You eat every day. Feed on the Word every day too.

verses.text: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.encouragement: Delight grows with time. Take a moment with the Word today.

verses.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.encouragement: The Word dwells richly where it is welcomed daily.

verses.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.encouragement: Give the first minutes of your day to Him.

verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.encouragement: Time in the Word is never wasted. It stands forever.

verses.text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.encouragement: Carry today's verse with you, at home, on the road, morning and night.

verses.text: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.encouragement: Come back to your verse throughout the day.

verses.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.encouragement: The Word is living. Let it speak to you today.

verses.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.encouragement: Start the morning listening for His lovingkindness.

verses.text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.encouragement: Let His words make their home in you, one verse at a time.

verses.text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.encouragement: Taste and see. A few minutes in the Word can sweeten the whole day.

verses.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.encouragement: Every verse you learn equips you for what today holds.

verses.text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verses.encouragement: Find joy in the Word today. It is food for the soul.

verses.text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.encouragement: Faith grows as you hear the Word. Give it your ear today.

verses.text: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.encouragement: Even a quiet moment before sleep is time well spent in the Word.

verses.text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby.
verses.encouragement: Growth comes from daily nourishment. Take in the Word today.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.encouragement: He blesses daily. Answer with a few minutes in His Word.

verses.text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.encouragement: Jesus made room for time with the Father. Make room today.

verses.text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.encouragement: Open the Word and let in the light.

verses.text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.encouragement: The Word you hold onto today will not return void.

verses.text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.encouragement: Continue in the Word, and it will keep setting you free.

verses.text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.encouragement: Ask Him to open your eyes as you review today.

verses.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.encouragement: Trust Him with today, and let His Word direct your steps.

verses.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.encouragement: Study is faithfulness in small steps. Take one today.

verses.text: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.encouragement: The Word restores. Come and be refreshed.

verses.text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.encouragement: Knowing the Word by heart helps you live it out when it counts.
